scope: Labelled origin supplements for April calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 04-01 04-31 listed reviewed April histories without origin wording; r154-data.mjs + build-r154.mjs (generated by makebuild.mjs from the round 151 helpers and the O-blocks of rounds 152–154) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r154.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Lithuanian comparison names in two-stem notes are checked against the LT calendar (lt2check.cjs). Skipped: names whose reviewed history already explains the word (Zinta, Zīle, Ziedīte, Tāle, Italo, Marģis, Armands, Karijotas, Gražvydas, Rimgaudas, Urve, Uku) and names without a secure base (Daivis, Aivija, Ainis, Naula, Hardijs, Feona, Nameda, Kaira group, Aimar group, recent EE register names). Rounds 153–155 share writer 1.9.130 and the audit research/namedays/round155-audit.json. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
